title: Shivtanium Network
description: An Open-Beta Czechoslovakian Minecraft server, fully made with custom plugins and resource packs, with fun minigames, events, and occasionally a Survival server.
body:
A Czechoslovakian Minecraft server, fully made with custom plugins and resource packs, with fun minigames, events, and occasionally a Survival server.

We have classic minigames like:
* Hide 'n' Seek
* EggWars
* Duels

And also some fully custom minigames:
* Battle Royale
* Horizon Battle

We occasionally host Whitelisted Survival servers, which require filling a simple whitelist application on our Discord server.

### Caution: Open Beta
This server is not fully finished, so things like in-game currency and monetization isn't our current focus.
